Subject: Need help with a wrongful termination case

Hello, my name is Siddharth Pai. I am a 47-year-old truck driver living in Panaji. My employer M/s Emerald Technologies Pvt Ltd owes me INR 36,50,000/- after firing me, and the dismissal followed a one-sided domestic enquiry. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 90128 56052 or email siddharth.pai@example.in.
